fields.mechanism: Dual-phase anticoagulation using citrate in both pre-filter and post-filter positions
fields.intervention: Integrate a citrate delivery system into the venous filter that delivers anticoagulant before and after the filter chamber
fields.expected_effect: Reduced coagulation within the venous filter while maintaining structural integrity and blood flow dynamics
fields.falsification_test: In vitro testing comparing standard venous filters against modified filters with dual citrate delivery under simulated high-coagulation-risk conditions
fields.mechanism_source_span: "RCA-two had the lowest adverse event rate (1.8% vs. 10.8%, 11.1%; p = .001), including less hypotension (0.9% vs. 7.6%, 2.0%; p = .023) and no muscle cramps"

fields.mechanism: Passive calcium chelation through surface-bound citrate groups creates an anticoagulant microenvironment at the filtration interface without systemic anticoagulation
fields.intervention: Design venous filter with citrate-functionalized polymer surfaces that provide localized calcium chelation only at the blood-contact interface
fields.expected_effect: Prevention of coagulation at the filter surface while maintaining normal coagulation function in the bloodstream, reducing thrombus formation within the device
fields.falsification_test: In vitro testing comparing citrate-functionalized filters versus standard filters in a simulated high-coagulation-risk blood flow system, measuring thrombus formation, filter pressure drop, and blood component activation markers
fields.mechanism_source_span: RCA-two (pre- and post-filter citrate) had the highest complete dialysis rate (99.7% vs. 97.0% [RCA-one], 97.7% [RCA+saline]; p = .037) and lowest venous expansion chamber serious clotting (score = 3: 5.4% vs. 16.9%, 30.0%; p < .001)
